language.label: Interface language
auth.key_instructions: Enter your OpenRouter API key. It will only be saved after you choose and confirm a PIN.
auth.replacement_instructions: Enter another OpenRouter API key. It will be checked before replacing the saved key. Your existing app PIN and conversations will be kept.
auth.pin_instructions: Enter four digits from 0 to 9 and repeat them. Remember your PIN or store it somewhere safe. Use the eye icon to check the digits you entered.
auth.pin_mismatch: Enter the same four-digit PIN using digits from 0 to 9.
auth.lock_expired: You can try again. Enter your PIN.
auth.reset_body: The saved API key, PIN and lockout state will be removed.
auth.lock_seconds: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
limits.total_help: The total limit includes input and response tokens from every request in this chat.
limits.completion_help: The response maximum applies to each response separately. Tokens remain reserved until the request finishes.
limits.money_help: You need to confirm the suggested amount yourself. This is a local safeguard and does not guarantee your OpenRouter balance. Funds remain reserved until the request finishes.
limits.money_text_error: Enter the spending limit as text
limits.paid_warning: Requests to this model may spend your OpenRouter balance.
paid.estimate_help: This is a conservative upper estimate. The final cost may differ.
paid.confirm_required: The request will wait until you confirm the new prices.
catalog.read_only: Only the OpenRouter model list is being read.
mode.choose_first: First choose a model usage mode.
mode.free_help: Free mode does not spend money, but request counts and model availability are limited. It uses openrouter/free or a model with all applicable price components set to zero.
mode.paid_help: A separate spending warning appears before creation. OpenRouter checks the account balance when a paid request is sent.
key.exhausted_notice: This key's spending limit is exhausted. Free mode remains available
key.unlimited_notice: This key has no separate spending limit. This does not confirm that the account has funds.
key.unknown_limit_notice: The available key limit could not be checked. Paid mode is temporarily unavailable. Free mode remains available.
key.invalid_notice: The saved OpenRouter key is invalid or revoked. Replace the key to continue using models.
key.restricted_notice: OpenRouter rejected the key permission check. Free requests may also fail. Paid mode is unavailable.
key.checking_notice: The key check has not finished. Free mode is available and paid mode is temporarily unavailable.
price.overrides_help: This model has pricing overrides. The maximum values are shown.
chat.create_help: Create a chat and choose its mode, model and limits.
chat.exhausted: The chat limit is exhausted. Change the limits to continue.
key.title: OpenRouter key
budget.title: Tokens and budget
key.replace_wait_check: Wait for the key status check to finish before replacing the OpenRouter key.
key.replace_wait_send: Finish or cancel the current operation before replacing the OpenRouter key.
chat.history_warning: History is stored locally on this device. Avoid sending confidential information.
key.invalid_short: The saved OpenRouter key is invalid or revoked. Replace the key to continue using models
key.restricted_short: OpenRouter rejected the key permission check. Free requests may also fail
key.unknown_short: The OpenRouter key status is not known yet. Local history and free mode are available. Paid mode is temporarily unavailable.
key.exhausted_short: This key's spending limit is exhausted. Free mode remains available.
key.limit_unknown_short: The key spending limit is not known yet. Paid mode is temporarily unavailable.
key.unlimited_short: The OpenRouter key is valid. No separate spending limit is set.
catalog.select_free: Choose a model for a free chat
catalog.select_paid: Choose a model for a paid chat
key.available_notice: Available key limit {amount} USD. This is not the account balance.
reserve.release_body: OpenRouter may have processed and charged for this request. Only local reservations will be released. Tokens {tokens}, amount {amount}.
reserve.unknown_free: The previous request outcome is unknown. A reservation of {tokens} tokens is retained. This is not the actual usage.
reserve.unknown_paid: The previous request outcome is unknown. A reservation of {tokens} tokens and {amount} is retained. This is not the actual usage.
chat.subtitle: {mode} · {model}
chat.delete_body: The chat “{title}”, its local history and draft will be permanently deleted.
meta.label: {label}
chat.title_text_error: Enter the chat title as text
